answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 840 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the yarrow. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the zephyr queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 272 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
